page0.text:
...
She must have said something aloud on purpose.
The Gandr's speed is slow and the black haze flies towards Kuzuki like a changeup pitch.

page1.text:
...
A wind of disease that will cause him to be bedridden for two days.
But two days of not being able to move would be fatal for a Master.
There has to be some kind of reaction if Mr. Kuzuki is a Master.

page2.text:
"Crap...!"
Tohsaka moves.
...Kuzuki doesn't react. Tohsaka's Gandr mercilessly hits Souichirou Kuzuki's head—
It is interrupted just before that.
A robe suddenly appears in the space between them.

page3.text:
"...Hmm."
The man who was supposed to be hit by the Gandr looks at us.
As if he knew that we were here all along.

page4.text:
"Tohsaka...!"
I immediately pull the wooden sword out of the bag and put magical energy into it.
I don't have the time to be fumbling around with Strengthening.

page5.text:
The swirl of cloth in front of Kuzuki now takes shape.
Slender limbs appear from the indigo robe.
Teleportation.
Actual teleportation is considered True Magic in this modern world.
This dark witch, Caster, uses such a Mystic with ease and appears before us.

page6.text:
"I have warned you, Souichirou. I told you to stay at the temple since things like this can happen."
She must not think anything of us, as Caster talks calmly to her Master...Kuzuki.
"And yet this is not bad. We have managed quite the catch."

page7.text: "True. The fish aren't that large, but there is no doubt thatit is a worthy bounty... Now then. Come on out, you foolish mage."

page8.text:
...
...It'd be difficult to run now.
No, if Caster and her Master are in front of us, then all there is to do is fight them, even if this is the middle of the town.
But, before that...

page9.text:
"Are you not going to come out? That is too bad. I at least wanted to see what you looked like."
"Ugh... What's with that fox? She already knows who we are..."

page10.text:
Tohsaka curses in her hiding spot.
She must've heard that.
"I'll give you three seconds before I send your own spell back at you, little girl."
Caster says cheerfully and points her hand towards us.

page11.text:
The absurdity of what she did before returns to my mind.
She's not that naïve.
I'm sure she would destroy this whole area, along with the wall that we're hiding behind.

page12.text:
"Emiya, jump out when I give the signal. Saber, are you ready?"
I sense her nodding behind me.
But...
There's something that I need to confirm before that.

page13.text:
"...Sorry. Do that later, Tohsaka."
"Huh?"
I don't wait for her reply.
I go out into the intersection from the shelter, wooden sword in hand.

page14.text:
"Hey, Shirou...!"
...Tohsaka must not have it in her to leave me alone in this and follows me out.

page15.text:
"Oh, this is unexpected. Do you understand your position better now, boy?"
Caster watches us calmly.
...Kuzuki stands next to her.
The distance between us is about ten meters.
No matter how I think about it, Caster's fingertips would be much faster than me running to them...

page16.text:
...
With full knowledge of the situation, I step forward.
I have to do something before we fight.
That is...

page17.text:
"Tohsaka and Emiya, huh? So you two are Masters as well, like Matou? Although you are mages, fate certainly still has its way with you."
...to confirm the identity of Souichirou Kuzuki as the one Caster is protecting.

page18.text:
"What is it, Emiya? You have something to ask?"
He asks in his usual manner.
I don't feel the presence of a mage from Mr. Kuzuki.
No, I don't even feel a desire for victory in this so-called war.
Then...

page19.text:
"Kuzuki. Has Caster put you up to this?"
It's possible that Mr. Kuzuki is being manipulated by Caster like Archer said.
Until I get this cleared up, I just can't fight him.

page20.text:
...
I can feel Caster's desire to kill me.
That alone tells me that question is off-limits for her.

page21.text:
"...Shut up, boy. I should kill you."
Yet her words are not quite a threat.
However...
"Hold on. Why are you asking that, Emiya?"
Mr. Kuzuki stops her in his usual manner.

page22.text:
"There must be a reason for your question. Tell me."
...
...My throat is dry.
It must be Caster's murderous glare. The woman in the indigo robe tells me without words that she'll kill me if I say something wrong.
I bear it and...

page23.text:
"...I don't know how you became a Master. But you're a decent person, right? Then there's no way that you're overlooking what Caster is doing.
But since it seems like you are, I just thought that you might not know about it."
I glare back at Caster.

page24.text:
"What Caster is doing?"
"...Yeah. She's holing up in Ryudou Temple and collecting magical energy from the people in this town. The coma incidents that have been happening recently are all her doing."

page25.text:
...
"The victim count has been increasing as well. As long as Caster continues stealing magical energy, I'm sure there will be people who will die eventually.
...She said that everyone in this town is a sacrifice. It won't be long before it's too late."

page26.text:
"I see, so that is what you mean. A virtuous person would not let Caster be.
Yet, as I am letting her run free as her Master, you thought I may be under her sway in some fashion."

page27.text:
"...Yeah. If you're still letting her be while knowing what she's doing, then you're just a murderer. I won't hold back. But it's a different story if you're being manipulated in all of this.
We'll just defeat Caster."
"No. This is the first time I've heard of this."

page28.text:
His statement leaves no room for interpretation.
He doesn't seem to be lying, either. Souichirou Kuzuki is the same as when he lectures at school.

page29.text:
"...Phew."
Though relieved, I still keep my guard up against Caster.
Mr. Kuzuki is also a victim if he's being manipulated.
So, all that's left is to defeat Caster—

page30.text:
"However, Emiya, are Caster's actions really so bad?"
And yet still...
Souichirou Kuzuki says this as well.

page32.text:
"It does not concern me how many strangers die. And besides, Caster has not taken anyone's life.
Though I daresay, Caster, you have chosen a half-hearted measure. If you are going to do such a thing, you might as well take their life."

page33.text:
"Wha—"
The way he says it is no different than usual.
He gives his honest opinion. Souichirou Kuzuki is the same as when he lectures at school.

page34.text:
"Are you going to involve innocent people in this...!?"
"Other people are irrelevant... Well, I suppose you have correctly guessed my true nature.
I am not a mage. I am just a murderer, spending his days wasting away."

page35.text:
Kuzuki takes a step back.
He watches us from behind Caster.

page36.text:
"You are correct to assume I am Caster's puppet.
I do not care about the Holy Grail War. If Caster and the two of you are going to kill each other, I will simply observe.
Most of all..."

page37.text:
I value my own life. I do not care what Caster is scheming. I just kill whoever gets in my way.
Do as you wish, Caster. It is up to you whether you let them live or die."

page38.text: Caster stands in front of us, smiling in victory.

page39.text:
"Ugh... So they're both underhanded foxes...!"
Tohsaka clicks her tongue and doesn't move.
Or rather, she can't move.
In terms of skill as a mage, we aren't a match for Caster even put together.
For Masters who claim to be mages, an opponent like Caster far exceeds what we're capable of.

page40.text:
"...I see.
Then, you do not mind dying here, Caster's Master?"

page41.text:
"...Huh?"
A voice behind me.
Before I can turn around...
The knight of the sword, the Servant Saber, dashes forward.

page42.text:
"...Saber!?"
My voice can't even keep up.
Saber, already clad in silver, charges towards Kuzuki like a gust of wind.

page44.text:
Caster confronts her with a spell.
She recites five verses.
If Saber is a gust of wind for completing ten meters in a breath, then Caster must be lightning for casting a spell even faster.
A bolt of lightning from a raging storm.
Five bullets of light are shot in less than a second and stab at Saber like fatal thorns...!
"Magic Resistance...! No, I do not know of any knight who can defend against my magecraft...!"

page45.text:
Caster screams.
Even Archer had to dodge Caster's spell, but Saber is nullifying it just by glaring at it.

page46.text:
Yet her focus is not Caster.
Her target...
The opponent that she must slash is none other than the Master, Souichirou Kuzuki...!

page47.text:
Saber slashes Kuzuki without hesitation.
"Lord Souichirou..."
...Silence returns to the intersection.
Saber is frozen after slashing her sword.
Everyone here assumes the match is decided because of how quick the attack was.

page48.text:
...Yes.
Everyone except Souichirou Kuzuki, who stands there calmly.
